data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Margy total 28, reducing to 1. Number 1 is associated with leadership, independence and initiative.

in_hebrew.name: מַרְגוֹגִית
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The name Margy comes from the Hebrew name Maragog, which means 'lady of Magog'. In the Bible, Magog is mentioned as one of the sons of Japheth and an ancestor of the Rosh, Kimmit, and Elishah.

in_greek.name: Μαργαρίτη
in_greek.long_meaning: The name Margy has its origin in the Greek name Margarites, which means 'pearl'. In the New Testament, there is a character named Margaret who is mentioned in the Book of Acts.

in_latin.name: Margarita
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Margy comes from the Latin name Margarita, which means 'pearl'. It is derived from the Greek name Margarites.
